title: The Joy of Programming in Jai - Part 1: Hello World
summary: The first part of a series on programming in Jai, Jonathan Blow's in-development language. It covers compiling, writing hello world and using code from other files.
why: Jai had no public release, so commenters point to this beta user's videos as a way to see what the language is actually like.

quote.text: One of the beta testers has published some more up to date videos with his language introduction and initial experience
